HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Con.]
Eructations : of wind ; loud, tasting of ingesta ; frequent and sour, with hardness and distension of abdomen ; suppressed, with subsequent pain in stomach ; offensive ; frequent, empty ; painful and acid.
Heartburn, and acidity rises from stomach after eating.
Sour rising of food. θ Suppressed menses.
Sour belching, < at night. θ Marasmus.
Nausea : frequent ; with tearing headache ; after eating ; of pregnant women.
Retching, with contraction in throat.
Nausea and vomiting during pregnancy ; slimy, watery.
Nausea, vomiting, eructations of wind and expectoration of phlegm, with induration and enlargement of ovary.
She wakes in morning very sick at stomach and vomits several times from 5 o'clock until breakfast ; substance vomited is white and frothy, followed by something yellow, like bile ; vomits several times during day.
Vomiting : violent ; of mucus ; of black masses, like coffee-grounds, in clear, sour water ; of chocolate-colored masses, sour and acrid, bitter, slimy, watery.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Con.]
Aching and pressure in epigastrium ; it extends from epigastrium up to pharynx, and feels as if a ball was rising to throat.
Oppressive contraction of epigastrium.
Sense of fulness and repletion in stomach.
Suppressed eructations, with subsequent pain in stomach.
Heartburn, with offensive, frequent, empty eructations.
Pressure in stomach during eating, contraction in back part with sensation of coldness, griping and sore feeling.
Violent pains in stomach, always two or three hours after eating, but also at night ; somewhat > in knee-elbow position.
Swelling in region of pylorus.
Pressing, burning, squeezing pain, extending from pit of stomach into back and shoulders.
A stinging seeming to come from stomach and extending under left ribs and as far as back.
Pressure and sore raw feeling at pit of stomach.
Sensation of soreness and rawness of stomach and abdomen when walking on stones.
Burning in stomach, nausea and severe vomiting of mucus.
Contractive spasmodic pains in stomach.
Spasm of stomach.
Cramps in stomach with tendency to constipation, especially in those of lymphatic temperament.
Spasms in pit of stomach extending from right to left, also to back, coming on in paroxysms ; before attack cramp in calves ; pyrosis ; throbbing in forehead to occiput.
Painful spasm of stomach, feeling as if stomach contracted, or of a heavy burden upon stomach ; she cannot bear tight clothing ; pain never entirely ceased, but was sometimes moderate, and then gradually became very severe ; tendency to constipation ; wearisome, spasmodic cough which < gastralgia ; cough < by talking, running, and by emotion.
Dyspepsia with acidity of stomach.
Cancer of stomach.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Con.]
Painful tension about hypochondria as from a constricting band.
Pressive, tensive pain in hypochondria ; stitching pains in hepatic region ; excessive colicky pains.
Aching in right hypochondrium, < by inspiration ; aching tension in left hypochondrium, extending low down in abdomen, with sensation of heaviness throughout abdomen.
Stitches or painful tearing in hepatic region.
Pain in liver with accumulation of earwax.
Pressing pain in right hypochondriac region, < from pressure, convex, hard swelling, extending towards precordial region and nearly to right crest of ilium. θ Enlargement of liver.
Constant pain in liver, with hardness and œdema. θ Uterine polypi.
Enlarged liver with pain on pressure ; jaundice.
Hard swelling of liver.
Chronic enlargement of liver or spleen, with torpid action of bowels.
Stitches in left hypochondrium and in spleen.
Enlargement of spleen. θ Melancholia.
Sudden attack of vomiting and diarrhœa at night ; vomiting of a white substance consisting of saliva without any admixture of contents of either stomach or bowels ; gouty diathesis. θ Acute inflammation of pancreas.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Con.]
Trembling of whole abdomen.
Flatulency ; incarceration of flatus ; rumbling and grunting in abdomen.
Fulness in abdomen, early in morning when awaking.
Fulness and bearing down in abdomen. θ Dysmenorrhœa.
Heaviness and pressure in abdomen or perineum.
Inflation of abdomen after meals, particularly after milk.
Swelling of abdomen.
Swelling in region of pylorus.
Hardness and distension of abdomen with frequent sour evacuations ; < during night, > by day.
Hardness of abdomen from swelling of mesenteric glands.
Sensation as if he must take hold of abdomen when coughing ; feels as if cough came from there. θ Anemia of brain.
Great sensitiveness of abdomen and sore feeling.
Child complains of pain in belly when coughing.
Aching pain in abdomen during pregnancy, every night, after going to bed, > by getting up and moving about.
Writhing and grinding (searching) in umbilical region.
Pressing, aching pain in abdomen, with involuntary drawing of abdomen up towards thorax.
Pain in umbilical region as if bowels were bruised by blows.
Stitches extending from abdomen to right side of chest.
Pinching pains in abdomen, as if diarrhœa would set in.
Oft recurring, constricting pains in abdomen, coming and going at intervals, like labor pains.
Lancinations in abdomen as if knives were plunged in.
Griping in abdomen before discharge of leucorrhœa.
Painful abdominal spasms during menses.
Contractive labor-like colic from both sides of abdomen.
Colic from incarcerated flatus.
Cutting in abdomen before emission of flatus.
Colic during emission of flatus.
Colicky pains of a most violent kind.
Labor-like contractions ; pain in iliac regions.
Contractive pain in lower abdomen, like after-pains, with urging to stool.
Constrictive pains in lower part of abdomen.
Pain in hypogastric region during menses, going down legs.
Aching pain in hypogastric region, like menstrual colic.
Forcing down feeling in hypogastric region, like menstrual labor pains.
Bearing down pain and burning in hypogastric region. θ Uterine derangement.
Pains in groins as if swollen.
Tumors in abdomen.
Enlargement of mesenteric glands.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Con.]
Constant inclination to evacuate the bowels to relieve soreness.
Emissions of fetid or cold flatus.
Involuntary discharge of feces during sleep.
Diarrhœa. θ Vertigo.
Frequent diarrhœa and copious urination.
Slime, mixed with greenish substances and containing bloody specks ; stools are very small, offensive, with tenesmus and discharge of flatus during passage, with a weak, trembling feeling after ; no pain at all ; eight to fourteen stools daily, the passages becoming more frequent at night. θ Chronic dysentery.
Stools : liquid, fecal ; mingled with hard lumps ; watery, undigested, and passed with loud emissions of flatus, with colic ; liquid, diarrheic, with colic, discharge of flatus and much mucus or undigested food, or even blood ; undigested, painless ; painful ; hard, with tenesmus ; very debilitating ; frequent and sour ; streaked with blood ; with discharge of blood.
Diarrhœa only by day, not at night.
Chronic diarrhœa of old men.
Constipation and diarrhœa alternately. θ Uterine polypi.
Constipation alternating with bilious diarrhœa.
Stools sometimes regular, sometimes hard and tardy, or green and diarrheic. θ Enlargement of liver.
Frequent ineffectual urging to stool ; or small quantity passed each time.
Constipation, with ineffectual desire for stool ; constant urging, without stool.
Stools tardy, hard and dry. θ Cough.
Hard stool, with tenesmus, headache and discharge of prostatic fluid.
Obstinate constipation, no stool for seven days, stools large, hard, and followed by tremulous weakness ; she must lie down. θ Prolapsus and dysmenorrhœa.
Hard stool every other day. θ Mental derangement.
Before stool : cutting abdominal pain.
During stool : burning, cutting and straining in rectum ; flatus ; prostatic juice ; rigors.
During stool a foreign body protrudes from the vulva. θ Uterine polypi.
After every stool, trembling, weakness and palpitation.
Heat in lower portion of rectum.
Frequent stitches in anus.
